data: In fiscal 2024 (the year ended December 31, 2024), Tesla reported total revenues of $97,690 million, gross profit of $17,450 million and income from operations of $7,076 million, according to its Form 10-K filed January 30, 2025. That gives a gross margin of about 17.9% and an operating margin of about 7.2%. Both margins fell from fiscal 2023. That year gross profit was $17,660 million and operating income was $8,891 million on revenues of $96,773 million, for margins of roughly 18.2% and 9.2%. Revenue rose about 0.9% in 2024, but cost of revenues increased to $80,240 million. Operating expenses also grew to $10,374 million, including $684 million in restructuring and other charges, which squeezed profitability.
